get.summary: Downloads files as ZIP file with optionally increasing the download counter
get.description: This API call downloads multiple file that are not expired and increasing their download counter is disabled by default. Can be set up to return a pre-signed URL instead of the zip file itself, which is valid for 30 seconds and can be accessed by any registered user. Encrypted files are decrypted by the server. Returns 404 if an invalid/expired ID was passed. Requires API permission DOWNLOAD. To download files that were not uploaded by the user, the user needs to have the user permission LIST

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: IDs of files to be downloaded seperated by comma

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: The filename for the new Zip file. If the filename includes non-ANSI characters, you can encode them with base64, by adding 'base64:' at the beginning, e.g. 'base64:ZmlsZW5hbWU='

parameters.name: increaseCounter
parameters.description: Increase counter if set to true

parameters.name: presignUrl
parameters.description: Return a pre-signed URL instead of the actual file. Valid for one download within 30 seconds and can only be used by logged in users. When this option is set, download counter cannot be increased.

401.description: Invalid API key provided for authentication or API key does not have the required permission

404.description: Invalid ID provided or file has expired

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of file to be downloaded

parameters.name: increaseCounter

parameters.name: presignUrl
parameters.description: Return a pre-signed URL instead of the actual file. Valid for one download within 30 seconds and can only be used by logged in users. When this option is set, download counter cannot be increased.

post.summary: Reserves a link for a document that is uploaded later
post.description: Creates a link without a document, so that the QR code of the link can be put into the document before it is uploaded. Get the QR code with /files/qr/{id}, then upload the document with /files/content. The link expires after one hour if no document is uploaded; until then it shows customers that the link is not valid. Requires API permission UPLOAD

401.description: Invalid API key provided for authentication or API key does not have the required permission

post.summary: Uploads the document of a reserved link
post.description: Uploads the document into a link from /files/reserve. The link keeps its ID, so the QR code in the document opens the document. The body is the same as for /files/add, and the link gets the settings sent here. A link takes one document. Only the user that reserved the link can upload its document. Requires API permission UPLOAD

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the reserved link

put.description: This API replaces the content of an uploaded file with the content of a different (already uplaoded) file. Requires API permission REPLACE. To replace a file that was not uploaded by the user, the user needs to have the user permission REPLACE_OTHERS. To replace a file with the content uploaded by another user, the user needs to have the user permission LIST. To delete a file after replacing, the API key requires the permission DELETE. To delete a file that does not belong to the user, the user needs to have the permission DELETE_OTHER_FILES.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of file to be replaced

parameters.name: idNewContent
parameters.description: ID of the file with the new content
